title: cytisus prostratus var. ciliatus
intro: Cytisus prostratus var. ciliatus, commonly known as prostrate broom or dwarf broom, is a low-growing, spreading shrub belonging to the Fabaceae family. This plant is used for its medicinal properties, providing health benefits such as antioxidant and anti-inflammatory effects, which may help alleviate symptoms of anxiety, insomnia, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Cytisus prostratus var. ciliatus include its ability to act as a sedative, hypnotic, and antispasmodic, making it a potential treatment for nervous disorders and muscle spasms. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
